messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Cut a through-hole with a 7 mm radius using a vertical cylinder at the big-end center.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.

response:
```json
{
  "match": true,
  "confidence": 0.9,
  "reason": "The edited part shows a significantly enlarged hole at the center of the large circular end (big end) compared to the original, consistent with cutting a through-hole of a specific radius, while the smaller end and connecting features remain unchanged."
}
```
